unlisted_practices: Dynamic, contamination-resistant benchmark generation for medical diagnostic LLM evaluation using clinically grounded confounders
Evaluating LLM diagnostics on veracity, helpfulness, and consistency beyond accuracy

screen.reason: The paper introduces and evaluates DyReMe, a dynamic benchmark framework for assessing LLM diagnostic robustness and safety dimensions (veracity, helpfulness, consistency) under clinically grounded confounders, but it does not evaluate an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
